description: This file is a Python module that manages deprecation warnings for modules within the 'pipecat.services' package. It tracks deprecated modules, issues warnings when deprecated modules are accessed, and provides a proxy class to handle attribute access with deprecation warnings.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A proxy class that issues deprecation warnings when accessing attributes of deprecated modules and handles attribute access accordingly.

methods.name: _warn_deprecated_access(globals: Dict[str, Any], attr, old: str, new: str)
methods.description: Checks if a deprecation warning has been issued for a specific module pair and issues a warning if not. Returns the specified attribute from globals.

methods.name: __init__(self, globals: Dict[str, Any], old: str, new: str)
methods.description: Initializes a DeprecatedModuleProxy instance with globals dictionary, old module name, and new module name.

methods.name: __getattr__(self, attr)
methods.description: Intercepts attribute access to issue deprecation warnings and retrieve attribute values, raising AttributeError if attribute does not exist.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, globals: Dict[str, Any], old: str, new: str):$/
ctags.signature: (self, globals: Dict[str, Any], old: str, new: str)

ctags.name: _warn_deprecated_access
ctags.pattern: /^def _warn_deprecated_access(globals: Dict[str, Any], attr, old: str, new: str):$/
ctags.signature: (globals: Dict[str, Any], attr, old: str, new: str)
